jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst Specialist - Treasury Full Time
jobs.description:
The Senior Financial Analyst is responsible for conducting advanced financial analysis, supporting budgeting and forecasting activities, and preparing reports that guide strategic and operational decision-making. The role acts as a key contributor to financial performance monitoring, helping the hospital optimize resources and meet financial targets.

  
  

**Organizational Accountabilities:**

* Ensure work is performed based on approved policies, processes, procedures, and instructions
* Identify opportunities for continuous improvement of systems, processes and practices taking into account leading practices, cost reduction and productivity improvement
* Ensure day-to-day activities are properly performed in line with policies and procedures
* Follow-up on escalated cases/issues of subordinates to ensure they are closed efficiently and in a timely manner

**Functional Accountabilities:**

* Assist in developing and maintaining the hospital’s budget and rolling forecasts.
* Collect and validate data from departments and ensure alignment with strategic objectives.
* Analyze trends to improve forecast accuracy and support business decisions.
* Prepare monthly and quarterly financial performance reports and dashboards.
* Conduct variance analysis (actual vs. budget/forecast) and identify root causes.
* Present findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Build financial models for new projects, investments, or service expansions.
* Conduct ROI, break-even, and sensitivity analysis to evaluate project viability.
* Collaborate with operational teams on business planning and decision support.
* Analyze cost drivers across departments and identify opportunities for efficiency.
* Support cost benchmarking, utilization tracking, and spend analysis.
* Recommend financial controls and cost-saving initiatives.
* Leverage ERP and BI systems (e.g., Power BI, Oracle, SAP) for data analysis and reporting.
* Ensure financial data integrity, consistency, and security across systems.
* Automate and streamline recurring reports where possible.

##### **Requirements**

Knowledge and Experience:

* 2–4 years of experience in financial analysis, budgeting, or planning
* Experience in the healthcare or hospital industry is an advantage
* Solid understanding of financial statements, KPIs, and cost analysis

Education and Certifications :

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field (required)
* Professional certifications (e.g., CMA, CPA, CFA) are preferred

  

##### **Summary**

**Experience Required:**

2 year(s) minimum

**Career Level:**

Senior

##### **Required Skills**

• advanced excel and financial modeling skills• strong proficiency in erp and bi tools (e.g., oracle, sap, power bi)• professional integrity and discretion in handling sensitive information• high attention to detail, accuracy, and analytical thinking• ability to manage multiple deadlines and work cross-functionally• excellent communication and presentation abilities (arabic and english

##### **Languages**

jobs.title: Portfolio Manager
jobs.description:
Real Estate Portfolio Manager – Sales & Client Relations

Company: PSR Homes Real Estate L.L.C.

Location: Dubai, UAE

Job Type: Full-Time

Industry: Real Estate

Job Overview

PSR Homes Real Estate L.L.C. is looking for ambitious, energetic and client-focused professionals to join our growing team in Dubai as a Real Estate Portfolio Manager.

The role focuses on managing existing client portfolios, building strong investor relationships, generating new business opportunities and providing end-to-end real estate investment solutions.

We offer an exciting opportunity to work in Dubai’s dynamic property market with an attractive commission structure and excellent earning potential.

Key Responsibilities

\* Manage and maintain a portfolio of existing real estate investors and clients.

\* Build long-term relationships through regular communication and professional client servicing.

\* Understand clients’ investment objectives, budgets and property requirements.

\* Recommend suitable Dubai real estate investment opportunities.

\* Manage client portfolios and provide updates on rental yields, ROI and capital appreciation.

\* Generate new sales through existing client relationships, referrals and business development.

\* Handle property presentations, negotiations and successful sales closures.

\* Identify upselling, cross-selling and reinvestment opportunities.

\* Coordinate with developers and internal teams to ensure excellent client experience.

\* Maintain client information, follow-ups and activities through CRM.

\* Achieve monthly sales targets and contribute to business growth.

Requirements

\* 2–5 years of experience in Dubai real estate sales or client relationship management preferred.

\* Strong communication and negotiation skills.

\* Excellent client handling and relationship management abilities.

\* Good knowledge of Dubai’s real estate market and major developers.

\* Sales-driven, confident and target-oriented personality.

\* Ability to manage multiple client portfolios.

\* UAE real estate experience is an advantage.

What We Offer

\* Attractive commission structure with high earning potential.

\* Competitive salary package.

\* Performance-based incentives and rewards.

\* Opportunity to work with leading Dubai developers.

\* Access to quality investor leads and business opportunities.

\* Career growth and leadership opportunities.

\* Professional and supportive working environment.

Why Join PSR Homes?

Be part of a growing Dubai real estate company where your performance, client relationships and sales achievements are rewarded. Build your career, grow your client portfolio and unlock unlimited earning potential.

Apply Now and become part of the PSR Homes team!

Pay: AED3,500.00 - AED4,500.00 per month

Work Location: In person
